items.markdown:
![22 Best Things to Do in Chiang Rai (In 2026) | Taylor On A Trip](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07262331-1672-0139-0000-4ee7a1fb9d1b:4)
Top things to do in Chiang Rai include visiting the stunning [Wat Rong Khun](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/) (White Temple), exploring the vibrant [Rong Suea Ten Temple](https://tayloronatrip.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai) (Blue Temple), and discovering the unique Baan Dam Museum (Black House).[](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/) [[1]](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/)

Iconic Temples and Art

- **White Temple (Wat Rong Khun):** A brilliant, modern white art piece and temple created by artist Chalermchai Kositpipat, featuring intricate details and an admission fee of 100 THB. Open daily from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.[](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/) 
- **Blue Temple (Wat Rong Suea Ten):** A striking blue and gold temple with a dreamy interior symbolizing Buddha's teachings. Open daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM with free entry.[](https://tayloronatrip.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai) [[1]](https://tayloronatrip.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai)[[2]](https://www.trip.com/moments/chiang-rai-551-shopping-mall-5/)
- **Black House (Baan Dam Museum):** A collection of dark, eccentric traditional buildings and unique art pieces by Thawan Duchanee. Open daily from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.[](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/) 
- **Wat Huay Pla Kang:** A massive 90-meter white statue of the Goddess of Mercy with a large multi-tiered pagoda and scenic staircases.[](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/) [[1]](https://chimptrips.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai-in-2-days/)

City Sights and Markets

- **Clock Tower:** A golden landmark in the city center designed by the White Temple's artist, putting on a short light and sound show at 7:00 PM, 8:00 PM, and 9:00 PM daily.[](https://tayloronatrip.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai) [[1]](https://www.expedia.co.uk/Things-To-Do-In-Chiang-Rai.d6094729.Travel-Guide-Activities)[[2]](https://chimptrips.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai-in-2-days/)[[3]](https://dimaak.com/blog/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai/)[[4]](https://www.bonvoyagethailand.com/chiang-rai/2-day-itinerary/)
- **Chiang Rai Night Bazaar:** A lively night market near Bus Terminal 1, open daily from 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM for local food, hot pots, and crafts.[](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297920-Activities-Chiang_Rai_Chiang_Rai_Province.html) [[1]](https://www.tripadvisor.co.uk/Attractions-g297920-Activities-Chiang_Rai_Chiang_Rai_Province.html)[[2]](https://tripwis.com/chiang-rai-thailand-guide/)
- **Saturday Walking Street:** A massive weekend street market operating Saturdays from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM with food stalls and local dancing.[](https://tripwis.com/chiang-rai-thailand-guide/) [[1]](https://worldtravelfamily.com/things-to-do-in-chiang-rai/)[[2]](https://www.kupi.com/en/explore/thailand/chiang-rai)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DijjgWCJt5E&t=73)

Nature and Day Trips

- **Golden Triangle:** The famous border point where Thailand, Myanmar, and Laos meet along the Mekong River, roughly an hour's drive north.
- **Choui Fong Tea Plantation:** Expansive green tea fields set high in the hills with a modern mountaintop cafe. Open daily from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.[](https://www.roowanders.com/chiang-rai/) [[1]](https://jonistravelling.com/best-things-to-do-in-chiang-rai-thailand/)[[2]](https://www.uniquefamilytravels.com/2019/10/04/touring-north-thailand-u-g-g/)[[3]](https://brokenlimitz.com/chiang-rai-things-to-do/)
